report: The game doesn't freeze, but there are similar graphical glitches to those seen previously. I've attached a longer video so you can identify which elements aren't displaying correctly and which dialogues are fine.

analysis_method: 26 overview samples plus 28 exact-time PNG witnesses visually inspected in contact sheets. No claim of continuous every-frame or audio review. Exact-time witnesses use ffmpeg -ss before input; overview labels are approximate four-second sampling intervals.

observations.finding: Large opaque white areas cover the battle dialogue region; white rectangles sit beneath unit sprites, with block-shaped cursor/overlay elements. Terrain and unit artwork remain visible.
Green unit formation remains visible over large white rectangles; later sampled effect animation and camera/scene changes continue. Missing early text cannot be identified from these obscured frames.

After the green formation is no longer visible, terrain/cursor render cleanly; later red-unit shadows are dark and shaped rather than white rectangles. Temporal association only; texture allocation/freeing was not measured.
Reamond portrait, readable text, dark dialogue gradient and advance marker render. Units and selection arrows remain visible.
A teal-haired speaker portrait and continuation text ending regroup! are visible.

Game reaches the mech-on-rock scene. Masked-speaker portrait and text, including the next page, render. The masked-speaker text continues onto a second page at 91 seconds; the first-page ending is not evidence of lost text.

NOW LOADING is visibly tiny and near the middle; expected old loading geometry retained by this diagnostic. Subsequent frames reach world map, so this sampled black/loading interval is not a persistent hang.

World map and labels (Alterias Valley, Glascher Valley, Flamuelk Castle, Muur Forest) render. Arthur and Clovis portraits/dialogue are readable. The recording ends on Clovis dialogue with an advance marker.

scope_limits: New Game entry, the Hallway and the Clear 2 menu choice are not shown.
Video ends during scenario.s_004.o00a04; it does not show the entire s_004 script or next mission completing.
No hardware memory capture, fault address, texture residency measurement or full-game pass.

interpretation.asset_group: With 0.7.36 explicitly confirmed, historical story-choice/map archives do not by themselves reproduce a freeze on the reported tested paths.
interpretation.earlier_hook: Supports the map-hook or its interaction as a lead at the earlier 0.7.27 boundary; does not prove a unique cause or explain the remaining full-feature 0.7.35 failure.
interpretation.graphics: Corruption changes within one scenario and later portraits/text/shadows render; consistent with graphics resource pressure or transient rendering state, not proof of a specific failed allocation.
